title: O Penn Mic
description:
O- Penn-Mic: From Curiosity to Creation

What if that random thought in your head could actually become something?
A question you keep wondering about. 
An idea you keep postponing.
A project you started and never finished.
Or simply something you’re curious enough to try.

This edition is all about asking, exploring, making, and figuring things out along the way.
No big ideas. No perfect projects. No pressure.

Just curiosity — and a mic to talk about it.

title: AI Policy & Governance
description:
AI is already making decisions that affect your life.

The real question is:
• How AI literate are you? • Who governs AI? • Who writes the policies that shape its future? • Why should you care?

Join Hawwa A. H. Hanjara, Global AI Delegate, for an engaging session on AI Policy and Governance. Gain a global perspective on AI regulation, ethics, governance, and why understanding them matters—regardless of your field of study.

The future of AI isn't just being built. It's being governed. Be part of the conversation.

title: What is Tinkherhack
description:
🛑*What is Tinkherhack 4.0?*🛑

Tinkherhack 4.0 is the world's largest women-only hackathon organized by TinkerHub.

We'll be conducting an *online meeting* to discuss about Tinkherhack.

*Date: 05/02/2026 (tomorrow)*
*Time: 7pm*

*What will be discussed in the meeting?*

- How to register for Tinkherhack
- Who can participate
- What activities and projects can be done during the hackathon
- Is vibecoding allowed 
- Last date to apply

All the above details and guidelines will be shared during the meeting. Mandatory for all those who are interested to participate
